welcome: `4The air deep underground here is thick, scorching hot, and reeks penetrantly of sulfur and scorched flesh. The floor is littered with the charred bones and melted remnants of equipment from legendary knights who thought they were strong enough. In the depths of the massive cavern, two gigantic, glowing emerald-green eyes suddenly light up from the darkness. The Green Dragon bares his razor-sharp teeth and a deep, booming laugh shakes the rocks around you: 'Hahaha! Another mortal who thinks they are a hero? Come closer... I fancy a lightly toasted snack!'`w
dragon_fysiek_atk: `4The Green Dragon strikes devastatingly with his gigantic tail. The blow hits you square in the side, launching you meters away against the hard rock wall!`w
dragon_vlammenzee_atk: `rThe Dragon breathes a massive, roaring wall of green fire straight into your face! The heat is unbearable and you feel your armor melting around your body. You scream in pain as you take {damage} fire damage!`w
combat_round_log: `2You take a deep breath, dodge the claws, and deal {player_dmg} damage to the Dragon!`w
victory_text:
`yWith a final, desperate effort, you dodge a deadly claw and drive your weapon deep into the monster's unshielded heart. The Green Dragon lets out a chilling, deafening shriek that pierces through bone and marrow. Green blood spurts from the wound and the giant crashes motionless to the ground with a massive thud.

Suddenly, the entire cavern begins to shake violently! Large boulders rain down. You have no time to gather treasures; all the gold you had on hand melts away in the rising heat. You run for your life toward the exit, pursued by collapsing tunnels and walls of fire. Everything around you collapses and you lose consciousness...

The next morning you wake up with a huge start in a soft bed in the inn of Oaktaven. The sun shines through the window. Strangely enough, you feel very weak, as if you have to start all over again, but your gaze in the mirror is sharper than ever. You are a legend. The town bells ring for you!`w
defeat_text: `4The Dragon roars triumphantly as he slams you against the rock wall with one gigantic claw. You hear the cracking sound of your own bones and your weapon breaks in two. The Dragon leans over you, his hot breath in your face. 'Too weak,' he whispers hissingly, after which he turns you into one big sea of fire. Everything turns black. You hear his sadistic laughter echoing long after as your soul descends to the underworld...`w
